desc:
Welcome to Christmas Tycoon! 🎄

Build the ultimate Christmas House! Earn cash, then buy buttons to unlock festive rooms, powerful machines, colorful lights, presents, Christmas decorations, and much more.

💰 Earn cash
🎅 Build your Christmas House
🎁 Unlock festive machines and decorations
💾 All your progress saves!

Can you complete your Christmas Tycoon? Play now and begin your festive adventure!
